flagship_project.name: Project HyperCloud-Test: Real-Time Hardware-Accelerated Virtualization Matrix & Autonomous AI Visual Bug Diagnoser
flagship_project.pillar: Distributed Cloud Hardware Virtualization & Autonomous Test Execution Engine
flagship_project.strategic_thesis: Testing web and mobile applications at global scale requires instantaneous access to physical devices without queue bottlenecks. HyperCloud-Test builds an automated low-latency video streaming and containerized mobile OS virtualization fabric with AI computer vision that detects visual UI layout regressions across 3,000 device permutations simultaneously.
flagship_project.tech_stack: C++ / WebRTC (Sub-20ms Video Stream), Rust (Container Host Orchestration), Python / PyTorch (Visual Regression Diffing), Linux KVM / QEMU, Redis, Kafka
flagship_project.kpis: Reduces test suite execution time by 75%; streams 60 FPS real-device screens with <15ms latency; automates root-cause visual debugging for 50,000 enterprise apps.
